name: io.github.samgovapi/samgovapi
title: samgovapi.io
description: SAM.gov entities, UEI and CAGE lookups, opportunities, exclusions and USAspending awards.

environmentVariables.name: SAMGOVAPI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. API key from https://samgovapi.io/dashboard/keys (free plan, no card). Without it only the keyless search and fetch tools are exposed.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. "Bearer " followed by an API key from https://samgovapi.io/dashboard/keys. search and fetch work without it.
